source.handlerBranch: default OpenAI-compatible multipart branch of handleAudioTranscription (the entry has no `format`)

vendorContract.precedence: the vendor contract wins over the OmniRoute source where they differ

openapi.responseSchema: TranscriptionResponse (200 application/json; the only response the operation documents)

models.deprecation: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2 (voxtral-mini-2602, voxtral-mini-latest): deprecated 2026-10-31, retirement 2027-04-30

fields.timestamp_granularities: array of TimestampGranularity (segment|word); the SDK sends one repeated multipart field named timestamp_granularities, without []
fields.temperature: number | null with no minimum or maximum

vendorContract.errors: no error response or structured pre-processing rejection is documented; the SDK treats every 4XX/5XX as SDKError and retries 429/500/502/503/504 only when retries are configured

checked: open-sse/providers/registry/mistral.js (serviceKinds llm, imageToText, embedding; embeddingConfig only; no sttConfig, no stt model rows, no voxtral ids)

open-sse/handlers/sttCore.js handleSttCore (no mistral branch; its default transcribeOpenAICompatible sends the same multipart wire but forwards every client field, has no deadline, follows redirects, and returns no acceptedJob)
src/sse/handlers/stt.js (reads AI_PROVIDERS[provider].sttConfig; mistral has none, so /v1/audio/transcriptions answers "does not support STT")
`git grep -n voxtral` (only the OpenRouter-routed mistralai/voxtral-mini-transcribe row in native-openrouter-stt, a different provider, endpoint and key)
localEquivalence.result: the provider exists but has no transcription path; the wire matches the generic multipart default, but registering mistral with format "openai" would forward unsupported fields, enable a translation route the source lacks and lose deadline/accepted-job handling, so this module is the delta

exports.mistralSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createMistralSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxTranscriptBytes } for tests
exports.buildMistralTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { body: FormData } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.mistralUploadFileName: (file) -> multipart file name (source getUploadedFileName: .opus as .ogg, audio.wav when unnamed)
exports.mistralSttRefusal: (status, { secrets, retryAfter }) refusal mapping that never quotes the upstream
exports.MISTRAL_STT_CONFIG: staged sttConfig for the existing mistral registry entry

models.passthrough: refused: transcription takes only the listed ids
models.dynamicDiscovery: none: the source lists Mistral transcription models statically; the registry's validateUrl (https://api.mistral.ai/v1/models) validates keys and is not an STT model contract

transcription.body: multipart: model, language? (^\w{2}$), temperature?, timestamp_granularities? (segment|word, repeated), file (name per mistralUploadFileName, part type from the upload or application/octet-stream); response_format=json is accepted from the client and not forwarded
transcription.answer: JSON object with string text (usage kept; usage.prompt_audio_seconds or duration as audio seconds)

integrationPoints.change: serviceKinds += "stt"; add model rows from MISTRAL_STT_MODELS with kind "stt"; sttConfig: MISTRAL_STT_CONFIG (format mistral-stt, translationModels [] so supportsSttTranslation stays false); keep every existing kind, config and the apikey auth mode
